entries.headline: NBA The Run’s first seasonal update adds five legends and practice mode
entries.summary: Xbox Wire describes the free Wave One – 2000s Legends update for NBA The Run. It adds five historic players, Drive Cam and Drive Flip Cam, Practice Mode, Custom Match and new courts. The legends can be unlocked individually with in-game currency or purchased together as DLC.

entries.headline: Satisfactory reveals paid Core Values expansion with an underground expedition
entries.summary: AUTOMATON and Gematsu report that Coffee Stain announced the paid Core Values expansion for Satisfactory. It introduces an underground expedition, a new narrative, factory buildings, creatures and biomes. No release date was announced; the base game’s platform availability does not establish simultaneous expansion releases.

entries.headline: Control Resonant developers discuss Manhattan, destruction and boss design
entries.summary: PlayStation Blog interviews Remedy developers about Control Resonant’s art and level design. The team expands dynamic destruction and reactive environments to Manhattan and draws on deep-sea exploration, cave diving and religious architecture for some levels and bosses. The protagonist’s movements deliberately convey effort and disorientation.

entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Quirky Duck Studios announced the single-player PC (Steam) simulation Paint the Moon on September 29. entries.summary: AUTOMATON describes the Football Manager 27 team’s interface explanation. entries.headline: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered: The Witcher 3 remaster reports PC save errors and a temporary workaround
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports save-error messages, problems reading old saves and settings not persisting in the PC remaster. CD PROJEKT RED’s Japan representative acknowledges the issue and suggests double-byte characters in save paths may be involved. The temporary advice is to use a Documents path without those characters or wait for a fix; the report does not establish that every user is affected.

entries.headline: Xbox Insiders test Mythic Achievements for completing original achievements
entries.summary: Xbox Wire announces an Insider preview of Mythic Achievements. Completing all original achievements earns the status; achievements added through DLC or updates are not required, and earned status is retained. Eligible past completions, including Xbox 360 games, are recognised retroactively. A new Gaming profile tab displays achievements, Gamerscore milestones and completed games.
